T17180:C2.why_not_browser: The pick walk needs a highlight whose working video is stored; the dev preset's highlights have none on a local stack (Spotlight shows 'This highlight's video is no longer available'), so a browser check never reaches 'Tap your athlete' there. The test renders the real OverlayModeView at phone-portrait and pins the guide as a strip in the page flow before the video stage, outside it and outside the floating coach host.
